commandSlots.title: Command slot monitoring & recovery
commandSlots.description: Only occupied slots are listed. The server checks operation state, leases and trusted container identity before recovery. An expired lease does not mean a slot can be released.
commandSlots.loadFailed: Could not load slots. Displayed data may be stale.
commandSlots.empty: No command slots are currently occupied.
commandSlots.unknownReason: The server provided no safe blocked reason
commandSlots.confirmDescription: This does not rerun the command or resume its task. The server validates the snapshot, owner, operation and revision, and only attempts release after trusted container cleanup is confirmed. Unconfirmed cleanup or changed state blocks recovery; this is not a force unlock. The list will be fetched again after submission. A completed request does not itself confirm slot release.
commandSlots.recovered: The server accepted recovery. Slots have been fetched again; use the list as the source of truth.
commandSlots.conflict: Slot state conflict. Review the refreshed list before trying again. Server information:
commandSlots.unconfirmed: Recovery was not confirmed successful. No slot was released in the frontend.

mcpEnable.label: Enable MCP tools
mcpEnable.description: Allow users to select enabled MCP tools in conversations.

toolPrompt.label: MCP tool prompt
toolPrompt.description: Controls when and how the model calls MCP tools. Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.

fields.defaultPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt

maxSelectedTools.label: Selectable tools per message
maxSelectedTools.description: Maximum MCP tools a user can select for one message. Default 32, maximum 128.

maxLLMCalls.label: Max LLM requests
maxLLMCalls.description: Total LLM requests allowed in one message, including the first request and final summary. Default 5, minimum 2.

maxToolCalls.label: Max MCP tool calls
maxToolCalls.description: Total MCP tool calls allowed in one message. Failed calls count toward the limit. Default 8.

maxConcurrentCalls.label: MCP tool concurrency
maxConcurrentCalls.description: Maximum concurrent MCP tool calls per service instance. Default 8.

toolTimeout.label: MCP tool timeout
toolTimeout.description: Maximum wait time for one MCP tool call, in seconds. Default 10.

toolRetry.label: MCP tool retries
toolRetry.description: Retry count after an MCP tool call fails. Default 0.

order.title: MCP display order
order.description: Configure how MCP servers and their tools appear in the conversation selector.
order.emptyTools: This server has no tools to order
order.saveFailed: Failed to save MCP display order

bulkConfirm.title: Confirm bulk action
bulkConfirm.description: Run this bulk action for {count} selected tools.

syncConfirm.title: Sync MCP tools
syncConfirm.description: Choose how to handle tool names and descriptions for "{name}".
syncConfirm.preserveDescription: Keep names and descriptions while syncing other tool data
syncConfirm.overwriteDescription: Sync names and descriptions returned by the MCP server

serverDialog.description: Configure the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint and credentials.
serverDialog.name: Server name

toolDialog.title: Edit MCP tool
toolDialog.description: Edit the tool name, description, and optional invocation capabilities.
toolDialog.toolDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe what this tool is useful for
toolDialog.imageRoutingTooltip: Only for tools that accept image data. The backend calls this tool first and the main model receives only its text result. Map parameters manually from the tool schema; fields are not detected automatically.
toolDialog.imageArgumentTooltip: Select the string argument in the tool schema that actually receives encoded image data.
toolDialog.noStringArguments: This tool schema has no string argument for image data, so this capability cannot be enabled.
toolDialog.imageEncodingTooltip: Match the tool contract. Data URLs include a MIME type; raw Base64 contains only encoded data.
toolDialog.passUserPromptTooltip: Send the current user input to the tool as well. Use this for vision tools that need analysis instructions.
